scenes.title: Key ideas
items: Active addresses can be inflated by bots or airdrop farming.
scenes.vo: First, Address ≠ person: one person can have many addresses; one exchange address serves millions. Next, Transfer ≠ trade: moving tokens isn't buying or selling. Then, Labels are probabilistic: providers guess who owns what; they can be wrong. Also, Active addresses can be inflated by bots or airdrop farming. And finally, Data provenance: know chain coverage, indexing method and delay.

scenes.q: Does an address equal a person?
scenes.vo: Question one. Does an address equal a person? [[pause 4]] The answer: No.

scenes.q: Is a large transfer a sale?
scenes.a: Not necessarily. It may be internal or custodial.
